title: GPTQ-2D: Cubic-Time Two-Sided Adaptive Rounding
abstract: arXiv:2607.27042v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Adaptive rounding methods such as GPTQ quantize the weights of a large language model (LLM) one at a time, propagating each rounding error to the weights not yet rounded. YAQA lowers the KL divergence from the original model with two-sided adaptive rounding under a Kronecker-factored Hessian, but its error feedback takes quartic work in the size of a square layer. We present GPTQ-2D, which provably computes the same rounding with cubic work, while still rounding the entries of each anti-diagonal in parallel. Its GPU implementation uses two levels of blocking to improve hardware utilization. We also extend the algorithm to Hessians with any number of Kronecker factors. In our experiments, GPTQ-2D is as accurate as YAQA and cuts the time to quantize Llama-3.1-70B-Instruct on a single NVIDIA RTX A6000 GPU from 8.6 days to 1.6 hours. Source code is available at https://github.com/IST-DASLab/GPTQ-2D.

translated_title: GPTQ-2D：立方时间复杂度的双侧自适应舍入
translated_abstract: 诸如GPTQ之类的自适应舍入方法逐一对大语言模型（LLM）的权重进行量化，并将每次舍入产生的误差传播到尚未舍入的权重上。YAQA在Kronecker分解的Hessian矩阵下通过双侧自适应舍入降低了与原始模型的KL散度，但其误差反馈的计算量随方阵层的规模呈四次方增长。我们提出了GPTQ-2D，该算法可被证明地以立方计算量计算出与YAQA相同的舍入结果，同时仍能并行地对每条反对角线上的元素进行舍入。其GPU实现采用两级分块技术来提高硬件利用率。我们还将该算法扩展至具有任意数量Kronecker因子的Hessian矩阵。实验表明，GPTQ-2D的准确度与YAQA相当，并将Llama-3.1-70B-Instruct在单块NVIDIA RTX A6000 GPU上的量化时间从8.6天缩短至1.6小时。源代码可在 https://github.com/IST-DASLab/GPTQ-2D 获取。
tldr: GPTQ-2D提出了一种可证明以立方计算量实现与YAQA相同的双侧自适应舍入效果的高效大模型量化算法，将Llama-3.1-70B在单块GPU上的量化时间从8.6天大幅缩短至1.6小时。
